title: One-plug umbilical
lede: Countertop version with neodymium. Real John Guest PP0408W unions and pogo pair, K&J SB443-IN grooved bars; the socket, plug and bundle are new.

panels.name: Machine side
panels.caption: Four 1/4″ holes, the pogo on end with its two M1.4 screws, and a K&J SB443-IN bar each side, its pole face flush and bare. Ø33.1 socket.

panels.name: Plug
panels.caption: Ø32.5 end to end. Four 24.5 mm stubs, the pogo pads and two SB443-IN bars flush in the face.

panels.name: Plugged in
panels.caption: The bars meet face to face. Each slid down printed rails in its grooves at a print pause and was printed over. N faces out on one side and S on the other, so an upside-down plug pushes away.

panels.name: Behind the face
panels.caption: All four unions at one depth, 16.13 mm apart (1.03 mm between them), collets 8.5 mm behind the face: the depth the pogo's M1.4 inserts and 8 mm screws need. The bars sit in front of the unions.

panels.name: Through the counter
panels.caption: The Ø32.5 plug in the 1⅜″ (Ø34.93) countertop hole: 1.2 mm a side.
